topic: Sequence RSA and Balanced Multimodal Latent Fusion Receipts
reason: rsa_12x12_geometry was computed with the same locally duplicated, incorrect SLOT_ONSETS_MS (531ms spacing) as the context-decoding receipt, and a 100-permutation null with no finite-sample floor correction (p_perm=0.000000 is not supportable).

See omission/tests/test_sequence_timing_geometry.py (permanent regression guard) and omission/outputs/classification/fig04_rsa_model_regression.csv for the corrected rerun (999 permutations, canonical timing, BH-FDR across the 4 model terms).

Corrected values move Stimulus_Identity to significant (beta=0.406, q=0.0337; was beta=0.320, p=0.034 uncorrected here) and Position remains significant (beta=0.479, q=0.0109; was beta=0.577 here) -- the qualitative Position/Stimulus-significant, Expected-null, Presence-null pattern is preserved, but none of the numeric betas or p-values in this node are current.

balanced_multimodal_fusion_pca_umap (AUC=0.867 claim) is UNAUDITED, not merely stale: compute_multimodal_manifold_battery.py was fixed for the timing bug but the fixed rerun was killed for resource contention and never completed (see outputs/classification/unified_multimodal_summary.json, marked INVALID_TIMING_DO_NOT_USE). This AUC=0.867 figure must not be cited as evidence in Fig04 or F07 until a completed, canonical-timing rerun produces a fresh receipt.
Original values below are preserved verbatim for forensic/audit purposes and MUST NOT be cited as current evidence.

rsa_12x12_geometry.scope: 3 slot positions (p2, p3, p4) x 4 sequence conditions (AAAB, AABA, BBBA, BBAB) across multi-area sessions

balanced_multimodal_fusion_pca_umap.scope: N=31 matched recording cells across 15 multi-area sessions (5-fold stratified CV)

grand_conclusion: Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) proves that cortical population geometry is overwhelmingly organized by Sequence Position (beta=+0.577, p=0.000) and Physical Stimulus Identity (beta=+0.320, p=0.034), whereas Expected Identity during omission is statistically null (p=0.169). In sensory-driven regimes, Balanced Multimodal Latent Fusion [PCA(S), PCA(L)] -> UMAP recovers robust synergistic information (AUC=0.867, Delta_L=+0.063), confirming our multimodal pipeline is highly sensitive.
